companyIntro.title: ‌Comfort and personality, both at your feet
companyIntro.description:
We have stuck to our original philosophy: we offer comfy, durable everyday styles for customers who value simplicity, and we also create eye-catching niche designs for people who love to express their personality through small details. We only make socks that we are happy to wear ourselves every single day. From selecting Xinjiang long-staple cotton, adjusting the elasticity of the cuff, to tailoring the three-dimensional heel, every pair of socks is tested and adjusted by us personally, ensuring a perfect fit that doesn’t slip, stays breathable and keeps your feet comfortable all day.

After over a decade, we still keep our small-batch, quality-focused rhythm. We perfect the comfort of our basic styles, and bring fresh creativity to our collaborative collections. We’ve also partnered with local independent illustrators to launch many limited-edition art socks — turn your favorite illustrations into wearable details, and add a little surprise to your daily outfits.

You can find us in our physical store in Shanghai, or shop directly from your couch through our online store at https://huangjinj.github.io/sock/.

Come find your perfect pair of socks, and enjoy a little comfort in your everyday life!

products.name: 3-Pair Trendy Slouch Socks
products.functionality: Fade-resistant prints, Non-slip soles, Soft-stretch cuffs, Moisture-wicking knit, Machine-washable shape retention

products.name: Abstract Graffiti Crew Socks
products.functionality: Premium Cotton, Abstract Graffiti, No-Pilling, Shape-Retaining, All-Day Breathable
products.description: These artistic printed mid calf socks are created for consumers with personalized aesthetic needs across European market. The premium Xinjiang cotton material brings you cloud-like soft touch, no itching or discomfort even if you wear them for the whole day. The retro abstract art design perfectly integrates the charm of classic painting with daily wearing accessories, which is highly favored by trend chasing young people and art lovers. The high density weaving craft greatly extends the service life of the socks, avoids the embarrassing pilling problem after washing. You can freely match these socks with sneakers, chunky shoes, loafers and boots to create different streetwear looks, no matter you are going for daily work commute, hanging out with friends or relaxing at home, they are your perfect fashion companion. We support mixed color wholesale, which can meet the stock demand of offline boutiques, streetwear brand distributors and online retailers in EU regions.

products.name: Art Socks with Color-Blocked Toes
